  TAIL DEFENSE  the game's keys, in the browser · td keys prints them

  moving    W A S D          walk, the way the view faces
            Space hold       sprint, while stamina (the blue bar) lasts
            E twice          walk to the nearest loot site in sight
            N twice          walk back to the generator
            right-click map  walk there, on the big map or the minimap
  fighting  Q                the weapon's ultimate, once its meter is full
            Shift            grenade: aim, then left-click; Esc puts it away
            F                dash at the cursor; a blade's weapon art
            V                airstrike at the cursor
            R                reload now
            1                medkit: heals over a few seconds
            2-7              pistol, shotgun, SMG, rifle, minigun, launcher
            0 8 9            crowbar, katana, greatsword, once you have them
            right-click      on a creep: focus fire on it
            J                taunt: every creep nearby comes for you
  using     E                revive, pick up, search, repair, shop or board
            G hold           drop the weapon in hand for a teammate
            C                armory: weapons, gear, abilities
  building  B                build bar: 1-0 and [ pick what to place
            left-click       place; or select a building, creep or player
  1–20 of 45
